finding: Only 3.04% of customers (2,887) place a 2nd order, yet repeaters deliver +121.57 higher LTV (259.95 vs. 138.38).
action: Launch an automated post-delivery 30-day win-back voucher targeting 'High-Value New Buyers' and 'Recent One-Time Buyers'.
quantified_impact: Converting just 5% of one-time buyers adds ~559,809.63 in incremental revenue.

finding: Northeast hubs like Bahia (BA) pay 26.37 avg freight (+74% vs. SP's 15.15) and wait 19.2 days vs. SP's 8.7 days.
action: Position regional micro-fulfillment inventory for top categories ('beleza_saude', 'relogios_presentes') outside SP and cap freight fees on baskets above 150.
quantified_impact: Reduces inter-state transit time by 4–6 days and lowers cart abandonment in high-freight states.

finding: Model projects 7,693,272.31 over the next 6 months, peaking in Nov 2018 at 1,427,004.05, while current late delivery rate sits at 8.11%.
action: Increase safety stock by 35% in 'beleza_saude' (1,255,695.13 historical leader) by October and tighten padded delivery estimates (currently 23.7 days estimated vs. 12.6 actual).
quantified_impact: Prevents Q4 stockouts during peak demand while improving checkout conversion through realistic delivery dates.
